mistral-ocr-2512.pricingNotes: Mistral OCR is listed at $2 per 1,000 pages. Free credits, discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

mistral-ocr-4-0.pricingNotes: Mistral OCR 4 public model-card pricing is $4 per 1,000 pages and $5 per 1,000 annotated pages. AutoShow plain OCR estimates use the non-annotated page rate; annotated mode is not billed because AutoShow does not request document or bbox annotations.

limits.notes: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/ocr documents the Mistral OCR API and OCR 4 model card. AutoShow does not enforce a numeric Mistral OCR file-size or page-count cap from that source.

mistral-ocr-4-1.pricingNotes: Ordinary OCR costs $4 per 1,000 pages; document/bbox annotations cost $5 per 1,000 annotated pages. Block extraction and confidence requests use ordinary OCR pricing. AutoShow does not expose annotation requests; the annotated tariff is available separately for pricing only. Discounts, batch rates, taxes and credits are excluded. The inherited latency heuristic is uncalibrated for 4.1.

limits.notes: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/ocr documents the Mistral OCR API and OCR 4 model card. AutoShow does not enforce a numeric Mistral OCR file-size or page-count cap from that source.
